# Sekar Bali Activity

> Premium, small-group village tours and authentic experiences in Pejeng, near Ubud, Bali.

## Overview
Sekar Bali Activity provides immersive, small-group cultural experiences hosted by local villagers in Pejeng, Gianyar, Bali. Activities directly support village community families and offer authentic alternatives to crowded tourist attractions.

## Key Experiences & Tours
- **Pejeng Village Cycling Tour**: Guided bike ride through sacred rice terraces, ancient water temples, and traditional Balinese family compounds.
- **Traditional Balinese Cooking Class**: Hands-on cooking experience using farm-fresh organic ingredients, preparing authentic Balinese dishes and sambals.
- **Organic Coffee & Farm Experience**: Walk through shade-grown coffee gardens, learn traditional roasting methods, and enjoy fresh brew tasting.

## Location & Contact
- **Location**: Pejeng Village, Gianyar Regency, Bali, Indonesia (15 minutes from central Ubud)
- **Website**: https://www.sekarbaliactivity.com
- **Direct Bookings**: WhatsApp inquiries available via website
